title: 'Claymore' Creator Norihiro Yagi Begins New Manga
content: Norihiro Yagi , the creator of Claymore , began serializing a new manga titled Batrlet Fairy Basslet on the Shounen Jump+ platform on Monday. Yagi serialized Claymore in Monthly Shounen Jump from June 2001 to June 2007. Following the magazine's discontinuance, the manga switched to Jump SQ.
author: MyAnimeList

title: One Piece Goes All Out for Fortnite With New Anime Opening – Watch Trailer
content: One Piece has now come to Fortnite as part of a major new collaboration between the two massive franchises kicking off this month, and the studio behind One Piece’ s anime really went all out to celebrate with a special new anime opening to start it off on an explosive new foot.

title: 'Charisma' Unveils Additional Cast, Teaser Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of the Charisma House mixed-media project unveiled a pair of additional cast and teaser promotional video on Sunday. The anime series will premiere on TBS affiliate networks at 11:56 p.m. on January 7, 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: 'Bocchi the Rock!' Gets Prequel Anime Movie in 2027
content: The official website of the Bocchi the Rock! anime series announced a new prequel anime movie subtitled Hoshi no Ashiato , revealing the main cast, staff, a teaser visual (pictured), and an announcement promo on Sunday. The movie is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Bocchi the Rock Gets Movie Starring Nijika and Seika in 2027
content: Bocchi the Rock is getting a movie in 2027 that stars Nijika and Seika. CloverWorks is animating the series with Shin Wakabayashi as director. Erika Yoshida is handling the series composition while Yukiko Horiguchi is designing the characters.
author: Anime Corner

title: Jun Kirarazaka's Blobtopia Manga Ends in 3 Chapters
content: Jun Kirarazaka announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Friday the Blobtopia ( Buyotopia ) manga will end in three chapters. The chapter published on November 6 will be a side-story chapter.
author: ANN

title: Hiromasa Okujima Shijūkara ga Naku Koro ni Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: Hiromasa Okujima announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Saturday the Shijūkara ga Naku Koro ni (When The Japanese Tit Sings) manga will end in the eighth chapter. The series follows the lifestyle of a 41-year-old businessman. Okujima launched the series on Fusosha 's Manga Spa! platform in December 2025.
author: ANN

title: 'Rock wa Lady no Tashinami deshite' Creator Launches New Manga
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account of Comic Heaven announced on Friday that manga creator Hiroshi Fukuda will launch a new manga, titled Koko wa Kagari no Territory (Here is Kagari's territory), in the magazine next issue, scheduled for a November 30 release.
